description: This file defines the TracesBuilder class, which manages and constructs traces for different trace types. It provides methods to set entries, timestamps, frame maps, and to build the final Traces object.

classes.name: TracesBuilder
classes.description: A class that manages multiple TraceBuilder instances keyed by TraceType, allowing construction of complex trace objects.

methods.name: setEntries
methods.description: Sets entries for a given trace type.

methods.name: setTimestamps
methods.description: Sets timestamps for a given trace type.

methods.name: setFrameMap
methods.description: Sets the frame map for a given trace type.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns the assembled Traces object containing all trace types.

methods.name: getOrCreateTraceBuilder
methods.description: Retrieves an existing TraceBuilder for the specified type or creates a new one if it does not exist.

ctags.name: traceBuilders
ctags.pattern: /^  private readonly traceBuilders = new Map<TraceType, TraceBuilder<{}>>();$/

fields.name: private readonly traceBuilders = new Map<TraceType, TraceBuilder<{}>>();
